name: Agents Platform Runners
description: Depends on the code-agent-clis app (claude/codex/copilot/cursor-agent already installed at /usr/local/bin, single source of truth) so this workspace's agent-CLI runners are what agents-platform_multitenant's agent sessions use, and contributes the ported "aw-agents" MCP (agent_mcp.py) so agents-platform is controllable as MCP tools from this workspace.

agents_platform_base.description: Base URL of the agents-platform_multitenant instance this app's MCP tools control. 172.18.0.1 is the agentic-workspace_default bridge gateway (== the real host) — the only address reachable from aw-app-mcp-gateway's nested podman namespace; override if your workspace's network subnet differs.

agents_platform_token.description: aw-backend identity JWT sent as Authorization: Bearer on every call to agents_platform_base — required, agents-platform_multitenant's require_identity() rejects unauthenticated requests with 401. Mint one inside the aw-backend container: python -c "from src.api.identity_auth import create_identity_jwt; print(create_identity_jwt(<user_id>, [{'workspace': 'aw', 'role': 'owner'}], expiry_seconds=<seconds>))"

apps.reason: This app contributes mcp.json definitions the MCP Gateway discovers and merges.

This app doesn't install the CLIs itself — it depends on code-agent-clis having already put claude/codex/copilot/cursor-agent on /usr/local/bin, same path aw-workspace installs already reuse: one app owns installing each runner, this app just depends on that instead of re-implementing it.
